# Baker Pro

Curated by Skill Harbor — a menu-driven AI pastry chef skill covering seven areas: sourdough mastery (starter, autolyse, shaping, scoring), laminated dough (croissant, pain au chocolat, Danish), cake decoration (buttercream, fondant, drip cakes), recipe scaling with baker's percentages, food cost and pricing, hot-climate baking adjustments, and a full bakery system for new shops. Invoke it with no argument for the menu, or name a topic and it parses and acts immediately. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @aiunlocked1412. Honest caveats: bilingual Thai/English — the interface and much of the content is in Thai; ingredient availability and climate advice are tuned for Thailand (hot, humid), so some guidance needs localizing elsewhere; covers a lot of ground rather than going deep on one topic. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
